title: CISF ASI Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 Online Form for 24 Post
intro: Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)  has Released Paramedical Staff Notification for Online Application form the Post of ASI (Pharmacist), ASI (X-Ray Technician)  & ASI (Lab Technician) Recruitment 2026 for 24 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to CISF Paramedical Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 8, 2026 & Last Date for Application is July 7, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: General/ EWS/ OBC : Rs. 100/-
SC/ ST/ ESM Candidates : Rs. 00/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Online Apply Start On : 08 June 2026
Last Date : 07 July 2026 (11:59 PM)
Fee Payment Last Date : 07 July 2026 (11:59 PM)
Exam Date :  Notify Later
Admit Card Released :  Notify Later
Minimum Age : 18 Years
Maximum Age : 28 Years
For Age Relaxation.Read the Official Notification.
Use Age Calculator:  Click Here
Must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) from a recognized Board or University.
Diploma or Degree in Pharmacy from an institution recognized by Central or State Government.
Must be registered as a "Pharmacist" under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.
Must have passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University.
2 Years Diploma in Radiography from an institution recognized by Central or State Government.
Must have passed 10+2 with Science subjects from a recognized Board or University.
2 Years Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from an institution recognized by Central or State Government
Pay Scale: Pay Level-5 in pay Matrix of 7th CPC (Rs.29,200 - 92,300/-) plus usual and admissible allowances to the Central Government employees from time to time.
Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of  Written Examination, PST/Documentation & Basic Vocational Aptitude Test (BVAT) and Medical Examination.
08 June 2026: Online Application Starts!
07 July 2026: Last date for registration (11:59 PM).
Exam Date: Notify Later
ASI (Pharmacist): 10+2 + Diploma/Degree in Pharmacy + Registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act 1948.
ASI (X-Ray Technician): 10+2 + 2 Year Diploma in Radiography.
ASI (Lab Technician): 10+2 with Science + 2 Year Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology.
Age Limit (as on 07-07-2026): 18 to 28 Years (Relaxation as per rules).
Pay Level-5 (Rs.29,200 - 92,300/-) as per 7th CPC + usual allowances.
Written Examination
PST / Documentation
Basic Vocational Aptitude Test (BVAT)
Medical Examination

Good Salary (Level-5) + Allowances
24 Vacancies – High Chance of Selection
